summary: Rewrote monthly_statement to send one GET /v2/settlements with only merchant_id, tz (canonical zone, offsets mapped to Etc/GMT with inverted sign), half-open from/to and a BCP 47 locale. It now uses Decimal rounding to the currency's digits and locale/currency-aware text. The docs conflict on tie rounding: the changelog and one search snippet say half to even, while the meridale-rounding page says half up. I followed the rounding page (half up, away from zero), so flip ROUND_HALF_UP in _amount if the dashboard really uses half to even.
